lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Na₂Co₂O₄ (reduced formula NaCoO₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in an octahedral environment of six O neighbors, while Na centers have eight O neighbors; O centers are five-coordinate, surrounded by two Co and three Na neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co octahedra and corner-sharing between Co octahedra and Na eight-vertex polyhedra.
